title: Build private image processing for owner logos
acceptance_criteria: Build the server-only private S3 processing primitive for the authenticated owner logo endpoint using Node24-compatible sharp, allowlisted decoders, byte/pixel/output caps, metadata removal and randomized tenant keys.

Only the current sanitized logo is served through controlled same-origin branding for an eligible published business; unlink replaced bytes after DB commit and never expose storage URLs, keys, or credentials.
Provide the owner logo reference contract for workspace APIs and the reusable private-media primitive for phase 4.
deliverables: Owner logo handler, branding route, private image primitive, and scoped tests
